title: Crestline Fleet Account Roster Rule: One Account per Vehicle
content:
A vehicle can be charged to only one Crestline Fleet Account at a time.

## Clause

A vehicle may be enrolled only when it is not on another fleet account's roster. To move a unit between two accounts of the same business, it is first removed from the old roster and then enrolled on the new one, with its unit number. Only vehicles recorded to the business customer on the vehicle record may be enrolled; an employee's personal vehicle is never put on a roster.

## What "on another roster" means

A vehicle is on another fleet account's roster when the latest roster entry for that vehicle on any other fleet account, as of the enrollment date, is an enrollment rather than a removal. The test is read from the roster records of the fleet accounts, before the enrollment is made; what the business says about where the vehicle sits does not replace the records. The object compared is the vehicle itself, across every fleet account.

## Condition table

| Latest roster entry for the vehicle on another fleet account | Vehicle on the business customer's vehicle record | Enrollment on this account |
|---|---|---|
| enrollment | yes | not allowed while that entry stands |
| removal | yes | allowed |
| none (never rostered elsewhere) | yes | allowed |
| any | no (for example an employee's personal vehicle) | never |

## Cases (hypothetical)

- A van was enrolled on a branch account and later removed from it; its latest entry there is a removal, so it may be enrolled on the head-office account, carrying its unit number.
- A pickup's latest entry on a sister account is an enrollment; it is on that roster, and it may not be enrolled on a second account.
